package.name: local_path_planner_cpp
package.description: C++ port of the Python local_path_planner — lane-follow + curvature speed limit + decel-to-target + decel-to-stop + hold + overtake (sigmoid). Phase B additions: /perception/tracked_objects collision check and /planning/path_confidence output. Publishes /planning/local_path in the same std_msgs/String JSON schema the Python version used so the existing trajectory_generator consumes it without modification.
